hypothesis: Increasing the temperature during primer extension by DNA polymerase will decrease the efficiency of DNA synthesis due to heat denaturation
prediction: The yield of extended primers will decrease by 50% when temperature is increased from 37°C to 72°C
measurement_method: Measure the amount of extended primers via gel electrophoresis or fluorescence at both temperatures
falsification_condition: If the yield at 72°C is not at least 25% lower than at 37°C
